description: Bitcoin only, beta. When the BTC signals snapshot was made, how old its newest value is, whether it is degraded and why, and every source with its own observed time and whether it was carried from an earlier run. Also the beta and not-advice notice. It is the only one of the signals tools that is purely about the age of the data. Also TSP's own verdict on each BTC price feed (`feed_freshness`: `tsp_status` fresh, stale, errored or null, as of `verdict_at`, and `last_updated_at`, when TSP last wrote it) beside the Wire's own verdict for the same series (`wire_check`), with `verdicts_differ` true when the two disagree; neither replaces the other.
name: mcw-signals-meta
title: Bitcoin signals: freshness and sources
